notes.title: Patch Updates v1.200422
notes.notes:
Hi Friends!

Armed to the Gears was just updated with some more improvements and fixes.
[list]
[*]4K compatibility improved (tutorial hints now scale with hud size configuration);
[*]Main Menu Welcome screen added with more information, links and options for new players;

notes.title: Gamepad Controller Update available in Beta!
Summer Sale Update!
Game Polishing Update
New Update: Easy Mode, Better Aiming, NPCs and more!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Here’s another important update with some cool stuff:

[list]
[*] [b]Easy Mode[/b] added: You can now select the Easy mode, besides Normal and Hard, in the Gameplay tab at the Command Room. This mode will increase your available energy from captured reactors, spawn less and weaker enemies and increase your power. There’s a 20% kill reduction as a penalty, just as the Hard mode has a 20% increased kill number as a bonus.
[*] [b]Better Aiming[/b]: Both the primary (machine guns, plasma guns, etc) and secondary (grenade and missile launcher) had their aiming calibrated. You may notice it’s easier to aim and hit enemies.
[*] [b]Four NPCs[/b] were added to the headquarters area, to provide background story dialogs, help and directions.
[*] [b]New sound effects[/b] for cyborg and mutant units (voices).
[*] [b]Turrets [/b]now have some idle animation while no target is acquired.
[*] Many assorted bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/6a6c44cbff6db77d4a9819431976766bd98e0463.jpg[/img]

This is also the first release candidate for the official game launch, so please let me know of every bug you find in the community forum.
Thanks everyone for playing!

notes.title: Leaderboards added in this new Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
In this update, we’re adding  a new feature: Leaderboards!

So far, we have a ranking for the players with the most enemy kills. To get your name in the leaderboard and then update your kill count, you must achieve Victory in any mission.

To view the full leaderboard and your position in the ranking, go to the Encampment Quarters and click View Leaderboards. It will open the Steam page in a browser window.

Highest Score (involving a sum of most victories and completed missions, etc) and Richest Player (most accumulated credits) are planned for very soon too.

We’re also adding new Achievements for all the current four Defense maps, to get them you need to beat every 50 waves on each base defense mission.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/46dd4c83b28ed0c13dd15b1698cfb5d9de4f442f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New game mode Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! As previously announced in the discussion forums, here’s what’s new on this Update:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/e37fcfc5807835d76dd48a359a0a5277b4d17734.jpg[/img]

[b]New Game Mode:[/b] In the campaign menu, a new tab [ Base Defense ] will be available with a new gameplay mode, a “tower defense” style, where you have to defend a base in the center of the map from attacking enemy waves, arriving in intervals. Initially at least one map will be playable, from a planned total of eight. This game mode is still being balanced and we need your help to make it the best it can be.

[b]Balance Weapons[/b]: Different weapons are now more similar in capacity and firepower. Laser and Plasma were improved a bit, Tesla is slightly nerfed, so the game is better playable independent on the primary gun you’re using.

[b]Lose weapons and equipment only when “Hard Mode” is activated:[/b] If you die in normal mode, your mech will respawn with the same configuration, fuel and warheads amount.

[b]Repair Turrets Using Credits:[/b] Turrets are now possible to be repaired with a new button in the HUD. It will consume credits while repairing, and will stop the repair process when health is 100% or credits are too low.

[b]Item Drops balanced:[/b] Many players were complaining that inferior weapons were dropping from enemies and they picked up and equipped accidentally. Now, dropping weapons from enemies is very rare, and when they do, it will always be superior to the one you’re equipped with.

[b]Weapons Crate:[/b] A new item box is being added, a weapon crate. Like the wood crate, it may contain a random weapon or warhead. This is to prevent accidental weapon picking but still allow for weapons diversity while playing.

[b]Save Mech customization:[/b] When you change the armor and fairings in the workshop, game will save your setup and reload it in every map.

[b]SFX Volume fixes:[/b] Finally the volume configuration will be persistent throughout the game.

[b]Loading Tips:[/b] A few gameplay tips were added to the loading screens. If you have any tips or strategies you’d like to share, please comment here and I’ll be adding them to the game with your name/alias on it.

[b]Discord chat linked from the headquarters:[/b] Let’s try some official discord chat room accessible from the headquarters. For now it will open it externally, I’ll check out if embedding the chat in-game is a possibility.

All of that, a few more general improvements and fixes. These are some of the final touches before the game leaves Early Access.

Thanks!!

notes.title: December Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, BIG update here!
Check out what’s new in this version:

[b]Customize Mech[/b]
You now have more options to combine and configure your mech’s appearance, colors and stats:

Main Armor Supershield (damage absorption, less damage taken)
Main Armor Thorns (damages enemies on collision)
Main Armor Regen (armor slowly auto-repairs itself)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/18757f183ea0a79e831c7a9d28b1f8eaeab4e089.jpg[/img]

Lightweight Fairings (fast walk speed, low damage resistance)
Balanced Fairings (average walk speed and resistance)
Reinforced Fairings (slow walk, high damage resistance)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/ce45b33969e8fe525c7cfb3ed28b4b7077f2dfef.jpg[/img]

[b]Attack Drone Companion[/b]
At the cost of 70 energy points, you can deploy a companion drone that will attack every enemy nearby.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/94b1e39ae59f31750d06bdc37758dca6b87e982f.jpg[/img]

[b]Fuel Refinery[/b]
Near reactors or randomly appearing across the map, you’ll find upgradable buildings called Fuel Refinery. They will produce one fuel item box per minute, if the max item limit is not yet reached.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/481d264f646cf88d467390327592267391a34b74.jpg[/img]

[b]Warheads Factory[/b]
Same as the fuel refinery, but will produce one warhead item box per minute.

[b]Random Areas[/b]
Every map now has a few places where random areas will appear. they can contain upgradable buildings, crates or just obstacles.

[b]More details on almost every map[/b]
Missions had some elements added and other issues fixed.

[b]Item boxes position lock[/b]
One problem with the full physics on item boxes is that they may sometimes fall on unreachable places. Now they are locked in their X and Z axis, so they cannot fly away from the starting point.

[b]Camera zoom toggle[/b]
Press the ‘V’ key to toggle between 3 camera zoom options, close, normal and far.

[b]In-game announcements[/b]
A “message of the day” feature was added to the headquarters to display the news in a more convenient way for the players.

[b]New soundtracks[/b]
Many new soundtracks were added in a total of 10 so far. The music will shuffle when the last one is over. 

That’s it for now, but more cool stuff is coming up.
I count on everyone to test and report any bugs or game-breaking issues that you may find while playing. 
Thanks!

notes.title: November Update
July Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Map 7 is here. It's a city ruined by war, and across the destruction and debris, there's a very well protected Ministry stronghold.

Protecting the way are the Seekers, a new dangerous enemy unit type, big aircraft equipped with 2 rocket launchers.

Some other changes:

Credits crates are easier to find and each now add more credits.

The Repair Station is now targeted by the enemies and can't be used to block them anymore.

To compensate this, new Barricades are now much stronger and will hold enemies for a long time, since now they are also targeted.

Please help us test these new features, feedback as always is greatly appreciated!
Thanks!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32104467/5bba1ee7dc0be2182ef88030a44f441c24dd8cab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, The new Armed to the Gears update is ready.
A few more days were required to make the new Launch Site Area the best it can be.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/923682177673320312/DC409D2DDCFEB7FADB64D762C55028F1C5E7A6CE/[/img]

notes.title: What's new on May's Update
notes.notes:
The second major update is on the go!

This time we'll have:
+ A new map, an ICBM launch site with 6 enemy bases to attack. Largest map so far.

+ More informative Deploy buttons: turret's range, damage, rate of fire and resistance.

+ Repair turret: Use credits to repair damaged turrets and structures.

+ Achievements: Earn them by beating each map. More achievements will come in the future.

+ New enemy: Soldier transport vehicle carrying 3 enemies.

+ Energy production: Energy levels will raise slowly instead of instantly. This will make the game more challenging and fun.

This update is sheduled to May 31.

Know more about this update in this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/804870/discussions/0/1696046976475818521/
